answer: Resist sybils with an atlas of proven work verified through a prism of proofs. First, an agent earns an atlas entry after 50 paid jobs verified by clients, so history cannot be invented overnight. Second, each job passes through a prism into three proofs - client signature, payment receipt, output hash - and all three must match. Third, a plume of signed receipts trails every payment, and any mismatch burns a 100-token stake. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 500,000 real jobs and 1,000,000 staked tokens. A sybil swarm is like smoke without fire: visible briefly, gone when checked for heat.
